weakness: No MFA on the SYS-01 administrator account; email administrator uses SMS codes
source: P07 assessment (IA-02(01)); P03 G-006; P01 R-003
remediation_plan: Turn on authenticator-app MFA for SYS-01 and email; store recovery codes in the sealed envelope (POL-01 7.7); password manager with unique passphrases
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on and tested; password manager in use
resources_required: Owner time (2 hours); password manager about $40 a year

weakness: Distributor portal B and the bookkeeper's SYS-01 account have no MFA
remediation_plan: Require MFA on the bookkeeper's account; use portal B for price checks only and ask distributor B for MFA in writing; carrier account PIN against SIM swap
milestones: 2026-09-15 bookkeeper MFA on; 2026-09-30 written request sent

weakness: No limits on outside systems; FCI in the consumer AI assistant and open file links
source: P07 assessment (AC-20 objectives); P03 G-003, G-020; P01 R-006, R-007
remediation_plan: Turn off training and delete chats with DoD lines; business plan for the AI assistant (P10); remove the 14 open links; named-people sharing; POL-01 8.2 and 9.5
milestones: 2026-09-15 links removed and chats deleted; 2026-09-30 business plan in use
resources_required: AI assistant business plan about $300 a year

weakness: No sanitization method or record; unwiped old laptops; phone traded in with no record; returned switches with customer configurations
source: P07 assessment (MP-06 objectives); P03 G-007; P01 R-012
remediation_plan: Write a one-page wipe method per device type (encrypt then reset for laptops and phones; factory reset and console check for network devices); wipe the 2 old laptops and the 2 trade-in switches; disposal record
milestones: 2026-09-30 method written; 2026-10-15 devices wiped and recorded
resources_required: Owner time; recycler certificate if destroyed

weakness: Garage and cabinet keys, codes, and remotes not controlled; no access log
source: P07 assessment (PE-03 objectives); P03 G-008, G-009; P01 R-013
remediation_plan: Key lockbox; change the keypad code; inventory keys, codes, and remotes; simple entry log; yearly code change
milestones: 2026-09-30 lockbox and new code; 2026-10-15 log and inventory in use

weakness: Router had a default admin password and internet remote management (fixed 2026-08-06); household devices share the business network; logs not reviewed
source: P07 assessment (SC-07 objectives, new finding); P03 G-010; P01 R-008
remediation_plan: Business-only Wi-Fi network (second access point or router) for the laptop; quarterly router settings and log check (POL-01 9.2)
milestones: 2026-08-06 password changed and remote management off (done); 2026-10-15 separate network in use

weakness: Router firmware about 2 years old; update testing approach and configuration management not documented
remediation_plan: Update router firmware or replace an unsupported unit; record in POL-01 9.3 that vendor-tested automatic updates are accepted for the laptop and phone; one-page settings record for the router and laptop

weakness: No anti-counterfeit procedure; 2 cloned optics found in stock and 6 from the same lot already sold
source: P07 assessment (SR-11 objectives); P01 R-001; P08 worked example
remediation_plan: POL-01 6.1 to 6.3 sourcing rule and receiving checks; quarantine shelf; report counterfeits to the OEM, the marketplace, and (for DoD orders) the prime; anti-counterfeit course; handle the found lot under P08
milestones: 2026-08-24 replacements shipped to the 2 customers (P08); 2026-09-30 receiving checklist in use; 2026-10-15 training done
resources_required: Owner time (about 15 minutes per non-authorized purchase); free OEM partner tools
